Records exported from each database (embase.ris; pubmed.nbib) were imported into TiAb Review (version 0.0.0-test) and deduplicated automatically. Titles and abstracts were screened against the predefined eligibility criteria by 2 reviewers, without access to each other's decisions.

A large language model (gemini-3.1-flash-lite [model version reported by the API: fixture-model-001] (temperature 0, top-p 1, thinking level low)) screened all records against the same eligibility criteria as an additional independent screener (inclusion threshold 0.3), using TiAb Review's screening prompt version fixture-1.

Before the large language model's decisions were used, they were compared with the reviewers' consensus decisions for 12 records (6 included by the reviewers). At the inclusion threshold of 0.3, the model missed 0 of the 6 included records (miss rate 0.0%), against an acceptable miss rate of 5.0% that was specified before the run.

Records judged include at the title/abstract stage by at least 1 of the selected screeners proceeded to full-text review. Disagreements were resolved by [discussion / a third reviewer].
